text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's finally begun! Golshi's ultimate<n>
multiple-choice one-question birthday<n>quiz!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Go on, pick your poison! Is your present<n>in my
right pocket—or my left? I swear<n>upon McQueen's
name that the correct<n>answer is one of these two
choices!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
In other words, the odds are a perfect<n>50/50...
Heh, now that's more like it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If you're gonna take this lightly, you'd<n>best just
give up. Answer right for the<n>pearly gates, and
wrong for molten<n>lava... Your life's on the line,
and you<n>only got one chance.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You gotta wager your life—that's what itmeans to go all in!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Sounds good to me! The<n>pressure's got
every cell in my body on<n>edge!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, my hands are tremblin'! Who<n>woulda
thought I'd be wagerin' my life<n>for my birthday?
You're a real one,<n>Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I knew you wouldn't back down from a<n>challenge.
There's no turning back now,<n>Nakayama! Now
choose—right or left!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whewie! Not bad at all! You got it right,<n>so you
get this carrot-scented eraser!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I gotta thank you, Golshi. Notevery day I get to feel thrills like these...Feel like a newborn baby right now.
